Local web servers for viewing results.

Generated from the `--help` output of SeekDeep 3.0.2-dev. Run `SeekDeep <command> --help` to see the same for your installed version. Commands and flags are not case sensitive, and every command also takes `--help`/`-h` and `--getFlags`.

## genProjectConfig {#genProjectConfig}

Write a project config file (\<shortName\>.config by default) pointing at a processClusters output directory, put the configs of all the projects to serve in one directory and give it to popClusteringViewer --configDir

```bash
SeekDeep genProjectConfig --help
```

**Required Options**

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--mainDir` | Name of the Master Result Directory created by SeekDeep processClusters **(required)** |  | std::string |
| `--projectName` | Name of the Project **(required)** |  | std::string |

**Optional Options**

*Writing Output*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--appendFile` | Append to file | `false` | bool |
| `--out` | Out Filename |  | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--overWrite` | Over Write Existing Files | `false` | bool |

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--debug` | Run In Debug Mode | `false` | bool |
| `--shortName` | Short Name for url for project, so only characters allowed in urls should be used |  | std::string |

## pmoViewer {#pmoViewer}

Start a local web server to browse a PMO (portable microhaplotype object) file by sample and target, with a haplotype rainbow page comparing samples, on port 9882 by default

```bash
SeekDeep pmoViewer --help
```

**Required Options**

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--pmo` | The PMO file to serve, can be gzipped **(required)** |  | boost::filesystem::path |

**Optional Options**

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bindAddress` | Address to bind to, defaults to 127.0.0.1 (localhost) | `127.0.0.1` | std::string |
| `--debug` | Debug | `false` | bool |
| `--name` | Name of root of the server | `pmv` | std::string |
| `--numThreads` | Threads for comparing samples on the haplotype rainbow page | `1` | uint32_t |
| `--port` | Port Number to Serve On | `9882` | uint32_t |
| `--resourceDirName` | Name of the resource Directory where the js and html is located | *(set when SeekDeep is built)* | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--seqServerCore` | Name of the seqServerCore Directory where the js and html for the core seqServer code is located | *(set when SeekDeep is built)* | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--verbose`<br>`-v` | Verbose | `false` | bool |
| `--workingDir` | The working directory to store temporary files | `/tmp/` | boost::filesystem::path |

## popClusteringViewer {#popClusteringViewer}

Start a local web server to browse processClusters results, one project per .config file (made by genProjectConfig) in --configDir, on port 9881 by default

```bash
SeekDeep popClusteringViewer --help
```

**Required Options**

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--configDir` | Directory of the project .config files made by genProjectConfig, each one is served as a project **(required)** |  | boost::filesystem::path |

**Optional Options**

*Miscellaneous*

| Flag | Description | Default | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bindAddress` | Address to bind to, defaults to 127.0.0.1 (localhost) | `127.0.0.1` | std::string |
| `--debug` | Debug | `false` | bool |
| `--name` | Name of root of the server | `pcv` | std::string |
| `--port` | Port Number to Serve On | `9881` | uint32_t |
| `--resourceDirName` | Name of the resource Directory where the js and html is located | *(set when SeekDeep is built)* | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--seqServerCore` | Name of the seqServerCore Directory where the js and html for the core seqServer code is located | *(set when SeekDeep is built)* | boost::filesystem::path |
| `--verbose`<br>`-v` | Verbose | `false` | bool |
| `--workingDir` | The working directory to store temporary files | `/tmp/` | boost::filesystem::path |
